appearance.extreme: Blades of bone stand a foot clear of each forearm, ivory and edged, wet where they came through. The wounds are already closing around them.
appearance.obvious: Ridges of bone run the length of their forearms, and the skin over them is split and rehealed a hundred times.
appearance.subtle: There are old parallel scars along both their forearms.

description: Bone has grown long and flat along your forearms and comes out through the skin when you want it to. It goes back in afterwards. That part is worse.
drawbacks: Deploying them opens your arms every time
name: Bone Blades
